complications.title: High Blood Sugar Today Can Affect Your Health Tomorrow.

cards.title: Heart Health
cards.detail: Uncontrolled diabetes increases the risk of heart disease and stroke.

cards.title: Kidney Damage
cards.detail: Persistently high blood sugar can damage the kidneys over time.

cards.title: Vision Problems
cards.detail: Diabetes can damage the blood vessels in your eyes and affect your vision.

cards.title: Nerve Damage
cards.detail: High blood sugar can cause nerve damage, tingling, numbness, or pain, especially in the feet.

cards.title: Slow Wound Healing
cards.detail: Diabetes can make wounds and infections harder to manage.

cards.title: Low Energy & Fatigue
cards.detail: When glucose cannot enter cells efficiently, it leaves you feeling chronically drained.

doctor.name: Dt. Dewyani Arbat
doctor.tagline: Real Food. Sustainable Habits. Better Health.
doctor.intro: Hi, I’m Dt. Devyani Arbat, with over 10 years of experience in fitness, nutrition, and holistic lifestyle management.
doctor.bio: Her approach focuses on understanding insulin resistance, managing belly fat, and building healthier habits without extreme dieting or starvation. Through the Metabolic Reset Blueprint, she guides individuals towards a more balanced lifestyle with a focus on real food, personalised nutrition, and long-term well-being.

faqs.question: Is this webinar suitable for pre-diabetic individuals?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Pre-diabetes is the golden window for reversal. The metabolic principles taught will help prevent progression to Type 2 diabetes.

faqs.question: Will I have to give up all carbohydrates and sweets?
faqs.answer: No. Dt. Devyani teaches smart food sequencing and metabolic flexibility. You will learn how to pair foods naturally to prevent glucose spikes without feeling deprived.

faqs.question: Is this an interactive live session?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is a live 90-minute masterclass followed by an interactive Q&A session where Dt. Devyani addresses attendee queries directly.

faqs.question: What happens after I complete my registration?
faqs.answer: You will receive an instant confirmation via WhatsApp and email containing your personal Zoom live link, calendar invite, and preparatory guide.
